slides.title: Introduction to Renewable Energy Storage
slides.subtitle: Capturing Excess Energy for a Sustainable Future
paragraphs: Energy storage is crucial for making renewable power reliable and scalable.
It helps stabilize grids and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
bullets: Solid-state cells: higher energy density with lower fire risk
Lithium-ion batteries: efficient and widely used in renewable systems
Hybrid systems: combining multiple storage technologies for optimal performance
slides.image_query: solar panels on a rooftop during the day

slides.title: Why Renewable Energy Storage Matters
slides.subtitle: Ensuring Grid Stability and Reliability
paragraphs: The global shift towards clean energy requires efficient storage solutions.
Energy storage helps manage power variations from renewable sources.
bullets: Reducing fossil fuel dependence: a cleaner, more sustainable future
Enhancing grid stability: preventing blackouts and brownouts
Improving energy efficiency: minimizing waste and maximizing output

slides.title: Types of Renewable Energy Storage Systems
slides.subtitle: From Batteries to Hybrid Solutions
paragraphs: Batteries, supercapacitors, and hybrid systems are the main types of renewable energy storage.
Each has its strengths and weaknesses.
bullets: Lithium-ion batteries: high energy density, low self-discharge
Supercapacitors: rapid charging, long lifespan
Hybrid systems: combining multiple technologies for optimal performance
slides.image_query: a battery pack in a solar panel system

slides.title: Benefits of Renewable Energy Storage
slides.subtitle: A Cleaner, More Reliable Future
paragraphs: Renewable energy storage offers numerous benefits, including reduced greenhouse gas emissions and improved grid stability.
bullets: Reducing carbon footprint: cleaner energy for a sustainable future
Enhancing grid resilience: preventing blackouts and brownouts
Improving energy efficiency: minimizing waste and maximizing output
slides.image_query: a graph showing decreasing greenhouse gas emissions

slides.title: Challenges and Limitations of Renewable Energy Storage
slides.subtitle: Addressing the Hurdles to a Sustainable Future
paragraphs: Despite its benefits, renewable energy storage faces challenges such as high upfront costs and limited scalability.
bullets: High upfront costs: inhibiting widespread adoption
Limited scalability: current technologies not yet suitable for large-scale applications
slides.image_query: a graph showing the cost of renewable energy storage systems over time

slides.title: Data: Energy Storage Capacity by Technology (2022)
slides.subtitle: A Global Perspective on Renewable Energy Storage
paragraphs: The global energy storage market is expected to grow significantly in the coming years.
bullets: Lithium-ion batteries: 54.6 GW/Wh capacity (2022)
Flow batteries: 3.4 GW/Wh capacity (2022)
Pumped hydro storage: 1,467 GW/Wh capacity (2022)

slides.subtitle: Advancing Technologies and Innovations
paragraphs: Research and development are ongoing to improve the efficiency, scalability, and affordability of renewable energy storage.
bullets: Solid-state batteries: higher energy density with lower fire risk
Advanced materials: improving battery performance and lifespan
